mainEntity.name: What is vibe coding, and is Pando for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe coding is building software by describing it. You say what should change, and an agent changes it. Pando is where those agents work: every agent you already pay for in a real terminal, a short plan you approve once, checks that Pando runs itself, Undo for anything you don't want, your yes before anything you can't take back, and one memory they all share. If you direct agents rather than type every line yourself, it is for you.

A goal you type on Home. Pando writes a short plan, you approve it once, and your agents work on it at the same time, each in its own copy of your project. Pando checks the work, an agent from another company reviews it, and your project changes only when you press Keep this change.

Pando does, not the agent that did the work. Pando runs your project's own tests on every task, or builds or lints it when there are none. Then an agent from another company reads the real change: if Claude Code built it, Codex reads it, or the other way round. Anything Pando could not check is listed as still untested.

mainEntity.name: What happens when Claude Code hits its usage limit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pando offers to carry on in another agent you have installed, such as Codex. The new agent opens beside the first one in the same folder and is told what you asked for and where Claude stopped. It is only an offer: nothing switches on its own.

mainEntity.name: Can I run more than one Claude Code session at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Open as many Claude Code terminals as you like, on one project or several, and see them side by side. Home and the left list show which one needs you. The Free plan runs 2 terminals at a time.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Claude Code and ChatGPT together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Each agent gets its own real terminal on the same project, so Claude Code can build while Codex, ChatGPT's coding agent, reviews. In a job, Pando has one check the other's work. They share one memory, so what one learns the other reads, and they can send each other messages.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an API key?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Pando launches the agents already installed on your Mac. Sign in to Claude Code, ChatGPT's Codex, Cursor or Grok the way you always do. Pando never sees a key, and there is no extra bill for the AI work.

mainEntity.name: What is free, and what does the trial include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Try Pando free for 7 days. After that, the Free plan gives you 1 workspace and 2 terminals at a time, with Undo, checks and the Brain. A paid plan lifts those limits and adds Pando on your phone and Pando Voice. If you stop paying, Pando carries on with the Free plan.
Yes. Reply to your receipt email, or ask from your account page, within 7 days of your first payment and you get all of it back, no questions.
Your Brain is stored on your Mac. Agents you connect can read it; cloud agents may send that context to their model provider.
